name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of Mars) — 1 Basic — War Cry

system.description: Activate this power with a symbolic gesture, war cry, or chant. For the scene, your Courage increases by one Trait and you automatically win all ties on Mental Challenges resisting hostile Discipline effects. However, your locked-away emotions give you the Negative Social Trait Tactless while War Cry persists.
